desc: Derive and implement add/remove updates for one A or B value using opposite-side Fenwick count/sum statistics.
Implement coordinate compression and Fenwick trees supporting prefix count and prefix value-sum queries.
Design and implement a two-dimensional Mo ordering of query points \((X,Y)\) with an appropriate block size.
Verify endpoint-movement complexity and practical Python performance for \(N=10^5,\ K=10^4\).
Implement robust stdin/stdout handling with Python arbitrary-size integer accumulation and validate against samples.
